title: A one-table writer passes picture-label checks without object information in synthetic controls
statement: P-G-020 has no eligible picture-label sample on the current public registry and practice split. The only AGREED folio is selected through a seat with zero effective links, and even the other agreed seat has no paragraph text on that folio. A stock one-table reuse generator sees no drawing or object features. On a synthetic layout it nevertheless gives eight of eight positive label-in-page results on declared image labels and on sham labels. It gives seven of eight positive feature-label results when feature groups are clustered by page. Exact-length, same-folio paired label-minus-sham comparisons pass zero of eight. These controls expose page-level dependence under the current global label shuffle.
check: Obtain more independent picture seats on folios with exact label loci and running text. Start by assigning independent second annotations of f99v and f102v2 to contributors who did not submit V-046 and V-047. Add more folios with paragraph text and compare agreement of link IDs separately from agreement of looks. Audit that the selected agreement entry has joins in each transliteration, then count public qualifying objects and comparison pairs at the fixed thresholds before registering a statistic. For label recurrence predeclare same-folio, length- and position-matched sham labels. If using running text segments as shams, exclude sampled and nearby lines from the searched text. Compare the actual-minus-sham contrast using within-pair exchanges. For feature sharing keep folio and relevant length strata fixed, and require several independent within-folio comparison groups so the null can move the statistic. Measure the stock reuse control and these placebos before using either statistic to assess a constructed language.

public_interpretation: There are 50 picture records on 18 folios. The two AGREED records belong to f72v1 and both have agreement 0.833. The pinned selector retains the first on a tie, V-026. That seat has 32 objects, no explicit loci and legacy clock fields without join-compatible typed angles. The current join returns zero.

The hypothetical alternative seat V-043 contains 30 valid label loci. This is a diagnostic substitution in memory, not a change to which seat the scorer selects. ZL, IT and RF each have 30 label lines and no paragraph lines on f72v1. All 435 feature pairs from that annotation are alike under the current predicate, giving no comparison pairs. The default requirements are 20 linked objects and at least five pairs in each feature group.

The two draft annotated folios f99v and f102v2 currently offer an upper bound of 23 and 20 eligible label loci, respectively, in each pinned transliteration. Both have paragraph text. A different contributor must annotate independently. These counts do not predict coverage in an unobserved split.

synthetic_setup.rule: The stock vs.generators.g_self_citation writer draws from one public practice training vocabulary and recent words on its current page. It is applied unchanged to the same synthetic line-slot shapes for all conditions. The unit field does not change its selection rule. It receives no picture inventory, label links, object-feature group, or declared-versus-sham role.
synthetic_setup.layout: Twelve fabricated folios. Each has six cycles of a running-text line, two one-word label slots, and a running-text line. Alternating parity assigns the two adjacent slots to a declared image label and a sham. There are 72 linked lines for either arm. The same synthetic outputs are reused across feature-group conditions.
synthetic_setup.global_null: Use the existing picture_label statistics and global shuffle_picture_labels. The toy check uses the default 20-object threshold and a positive value with one-sided p <= 0.01 from 399 permutations. Neither the method nor the threshold is proposed as a validated manuscript fact.
synthetic_setup.ablations: Shuffle all generated word slots globally to preserve the overall word stock and the original number of slots per line while breaking page-local recurrence. For the feature test contrast a feature palette unique by folio with the same colours represented in every folio. The generated text and label links are identical in the two feature arms.
synthetic_setup.paired_comparison: Match actual-designated and sham one-word labels by exact EVA-basic glyph length of at least three within each synthetic folio. Use order by label slot for ties. Subtract the sham own-page-minus-other-page match indicator from the declared label indicator. Use a one-sided label-exchange null by swapping the pair signs 399 times. Use 20 matched pairs and p<=0.01 as the minimum and threshold.

limits: The synthetic shapes are designed to expose page dependence. They establish that a no-drawing rule can pass at the stated thresholds, without estimating whether any particular manuscript labels refer to drawings.

Shuffling label lines inside one folio keeps their multiset fixed and leaves label-in-page recurrence unchanged. On the pure folio-clustered feature fixture it also leaves all feature comparisons unchanged. The diagnostic checks this explicitly, so moving the existing shuffle within folio is insufficient on its own.

The stock public self-citation control is explicit and reproducible here. The archived one-table/no-drift narrative from P-G-007 lacks the exact matching stream; other deposited variants use drift or several tables. This does not substitute those variants for a later manuscript-matched one-table control.

reproduction.instruction: Put the three strings in one temporary directory. With the public pinned inputs fetched, put the checkout on PYTHONPATH and run the three Python programs. They use only the public registry, public practice, and fabricated evaluation layouts.
